about: The rules vocabulary every catalog refers to: attributes, damage kinds, save categories and the procedures the world rules call by name.

camp_recovery.name: Sheltered recovery
camp_recovery.effect: Heal 9999 health to party. Grant 9999 slots to party. Remove bleeding from party.
camp_recovery.description: A night under a roof or a well-kept camp: wounds close, spells are relearned, bleeding stops.

rough_rest.name: A night in the open
rough_rest.effect: Heal (1d6 + 2) health to party. Grant (1) slots to party. Remove bleeding from party.
rough_rest.description: A cold night on hard ground: some rest, no more.
